cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The lift costs petrol and a proper conversation about why you stopped calling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Good. That gets the car moving, not us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we discuss it another day?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then today costs petrol and another postponed conversation. The second price is rising.

mechanism: A prices a lift in petrol and a pupil honest explanation, raising the emotional debt when the pupil tries to pay only money or postpone the talk.
confusable: Not one fixed trade: practical price remains while each renewed offer increases personal acknowledgment owed.
comparison: Fuel plus relationship repair versus dress fee plus public reversal of mocked taste.
seedUse: D238 lift/petrol/stopped calling/pay/later/rising cost; S05 keeping promises.
